summary: The Control Center's unavailable integrations were re-audited against current code and three reasons that had outlived their causes were corrected: RunPod is now compute_adapter_not_wired_into_launch (carbon.compute implements the pod lifecycle, but no launch path dispatches to it, so configuring a key changes nothing); Chutes is no_chutes_adapter_generic_chat_adapter_unexercised_against_it (the generic OpenAI-compatible chat adapter reaches any endpoint the miner names, but Chutes has no adapter of its own and Carbon has not exercised one against it), with a next action pointing at that adapter; and the remote door's comment no longer calls its hosting undecided, naming the owner's section 4 security review as what gates external reach. A new test ties each code-describing reason to a probe of the code that makes it true (no launch-path module imports carbon.compute; no Chutes or Hermes adapter; no Lium compute provider; nothing that serves an app touches the remote door), each with a specimen showing its search finds what is present, so a reason fails its test when its cause goes away. DEVELOPMENT only; no provider was contacted.
